property_summary: For every long order filled via fillOrder, the contract must record the position expiration (block.timestamp + duration) under the order's own hash key in positionExpirations; the mutant stores it under the opposite-order position id instead, leaving the orderHash key unset for long fills.
change_summary: Always store the expiration under the opposite-order positionId instead of conditionally choosing between orderHash and positionId, so for long fills the key written changes.
